notes:
[Added]
- Support WaEnhancer-style `background-color: #old #new` color replacement, three-color `color-tint` states, `left`/`top`/`right`/`bottom` offsets and `rgb()`/`rgba()`/`#rgb` colors in custom theme CSS.
- Apply `change_dpi` from a theme's header comment when no DPI is set.

[Fixes]
- Load custom theme CSS from per-target-app settings instead of showing an unthemed WhatsApp in Per Target App mode.
- Keep themed backgrounds, images and visibility in place when WhatsApp rebinds a view, and match activity-scoped rules on activity subclasses.
- Match selector chains, `:nth-child` and widget types the same way as WaEnhancer themes expect.
- Reject invalid CSS in the editor with the same checks the theme engine applies.
- Keep double-tap reactions bound to the current message and conversation, preventing stale recycled views from reacting to the wrong message.

[Improvements]
- Rebuild the custom theme CSS engine around a precompiled view-id index, so themes no longer slow down scrolling.
